notes.title: Full Release!
notes.notes:
Paths Taken is now fully released! The full game is 30,000+ words with 4 routes, each with achievements. This game has been in development for over 4 years due to a lot of bumps, but we hope you guys enjoy the full game!

[b]If you want to get updates on our games in progress, [url=https://twitter.com/CrystalGameWork]follow us on Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4]join our Discord[/url]![/b] If you like Paths Taken and want more free yuri games, try our previous title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054560/Alice_in_Stardom__A_Free_Idol_Visual_Novel/]Alice in Stardom[/url]!
